entities.summary: Arsen Sergeyevich Pavlov, known by his nom de guerre Motorola (Моторола), was a Russian militant known for murdering and torturing Ukrainian POWs, who led the Sparta Battalion up until his death in an explosion in his apartment building elevator in Donetsk.
